english.note: Use this when 'easily' emphasizes being physically comfortable or relaxed, rather than merely having no difficulty.

examples.english: After dinner, I can easily relax on the sofa and watch TV.
examples.traditional: 我食完飯就可以舒舒服服咁喺梳化度睇電視。
